adaptive_scope.changes: training handoff and ordinary case identities at ten-update boundaries
adaptive_scope.evidence: immediately preceding completed training stage only
adaptive_scope.ordinary_policy: 80% frontier with 10% mastered and 10% stalled anchors, selected only within the frozen policy/opponent-family slot

final_selection_rule: earliest checkpoint with positive communication, specificity, and RL-specific lift; ordinary hard/legacy point estimates nonnegative; confirmatory intervals reserved for the larger development/frozen evaluation
initializer_claim_boundary: continuation warm start; V13 did not pass communication claim
objective: convert verified receiver capture dependence into specific terminal team return

selection_policy.classification: frontier iff complete pass@4 returns vary; otherwise mastered for positive flat return and stalled for nonpositive flat return
selection_policy.unseen_cases: frontier until one complete logical group is observed

policy.classification: frontier iff complete pass@4 returns vary; otherwise mastered for positive flat return and stalled for nonpositive flat return
policy.unseen_cases: frontier until one complete logical group is observed

stage_gate_policy: withhold continuation on any failed predeclared gate
